: 
Sudhir Kumar Rai, Dhirendra Vikram Singh 
Counsel for Opposite Party(s)
Israr Ali vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home. Lko on 7 October, 2025

: 
G.A. 
Court No. - 12
 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.
2.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.60 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B Ipc
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Purva, District Unnao.

3. The Fir in question was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant was married to the
applicant in the year 2023 and subsequently, dowry was being demanded and the entire
matrimonial family had killed the daughter of the informant.
4.

Learned counsel for the applicant states that the informant has turned hostile and has not
supported the prosecution story - his statement is on record alongwith affidavit dated 01.05.2025.
5.
Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
6. Considering the said statement, the applicant who is in custody since 04.04.2024 and has no criminal antecedent, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Israr Ali be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(Pankaj Bhatia,J.) October 7, 2025 nishant  Israr Ali vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home.
